battle.name: 邙山之戰 (564年)
battle.brief: 唐高宗朝，東突厥犯邊，洛陽以北的邙山成為替兵之地。薛仁貴以邏娑道行軍大總管統諸道兵馬，與契苾何力所部在山前與突厥交戰，破之，斬首數千級，來降部落甚多。卡面這件羅馬弩砲不在此役：它是公元前1世紀的蓄力式攻城器械，564年前後唐軍對位的同類兵器是弩砲與砲車。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 這場交戰的兩方是唐王朝與東突厥。唐高宗李治在位，649年即位、683年崩，年號麟德；朝廷在關內正忙着收拾西北與西南的邊患，北方卻在入冬之後重新緊張起來，突厥一部越過塞下，南逼河洛。唐廷的應法不是讓沿邊各州分頭抵禦，而是把主力集在洛陽，一次用出去。邙山在洛陽城正北、黃河南岸，是一道東西走向的土崗，嶺北下來的馬隊要從山間谷口與河灘狹窄處通過，屯兵於此，等於把河洛的門戶握在手上。洛陽是唐的東都，也是北方漕運的終點，倉儲、兵械與援兵都從這裡發放。兵權分兩層統帥：高宗自為行營主，以邏娑道行軍大總管總領諸道兵馬，其下各道行軍總管各領本道，副將、判官、行軍司馬分掌兵、糧、械；軍令自中書省與兵部發出，邊軍的兵額則由河南、河北、幽州諸道就近支給。突厥一方是遊牧的部族聯盟，牙帳在漠北，汗庭之下有數十個部落，各有首領與部眾，秋冬南下以騎兵為主，靠盟誓與婚姻維持，既能合兵也能各自求和。兩方之間還有第三種身分的人：已率部歸唐的突厥內附首領，契苾何力便是其中之一，他在這一役站在唐軍一邊作嚮導。
countriesEn: The two sides in this engagement were the Tang dynasty and the Eastern Turkic Khaganate. Emperor Gaozong of Tang, Li Zhi, was on the throne, having taken it in 649 and dying in 683, in the Linde era; while the court was busy settling the frontier in the north-west and the south-west, the north had turned tense again as winter closed in, and a branch of the Turks crossed the frontier and pressed down towards Heluo. The court's answer was not to let the frontier prefectures each block the invaders on their own, but to concentrate the main force at Luoyang and use it in a single stroke. Mount Mang lies directly north of the city of Luoyang, on the south bank of the Yellow River, and is a ridge of loess running east and west; the horse columns coming down from the north had to pass through the gullies between the hills and along the narrow strips of river bank, so a camp at this point was in effect a grip on the gateway of Heluo. Luoyang was the eastern capital of Tang and the terminus of the northern grain transport, and the stores, the arms and the reinforcements were all issued from there. Command was arranged in two layers. Gaozong himself held the field camp, with a Grand Commander of the March of the Luosa route commanding the armies of the several circuits; under him the commanders of the circuits led their own men, while the deputy generals, the civil registrars and the army judges took charge of the soldiers, the grain and the equipment in turn. The orders travelled from the Secretariat and the Ministry of War, and the frontier garrisons were fed by the circuits of Henan, Hebei and Youzhou close at hand. On the Turkic side was a nomadic confederation of tribes whose tent of the khagan stood in the northern steppe: under it were several dozen tribes, each with its own leader and its own followers, going south in autumn and winter mainly on horseback, held together by oaths of alliance and by marriage, able to combine into one host and equally able to seek terms on their own account. Between the two sides stood a third kind of person, the Turkic chieftains who had already brought their people over to Tang and were settled within the empire, and Qiebin Heli was one of these, standing on the Tang side in this battle as a guide.
people: 留下姓名的，唐一方有三人最關鍵。第一是皇帝高宗李治，他下詔出師並自將大軍屯於洛陽以北的邙山，把行營安在東都之北，等於把朝廷的樣子擺在草原騎兵與中原之間；他在咸亨以後已多次北巡，熟悉河洛山川，這次選點並非偶然。第二是薛仁貴，舊唐書卷八十一、新唐書卷九十三都有他的傳：河東絳州龍門人，早年流落州里，靠招募義士起家，貞觀末年以軍功顯名，先後與高句麗、突厥交過手，麟德年間出任邏娑道行軍大總管，與突厥接戰的第一線由他指揮，戰後把斬獲與來降名冊一併上報，朝廷因此加授兵馬之任。第三是契苾何力，突厥契苾部的首領，早年率眾歸唐，受唐封官，麟德年間隨軍出戰，在山前擔任嚮導，是唯一能用突厥語直接與對方騎隊打交道的人；此後他在唐與突厥之間往來數十年，隋文帝開皇年間再為內應而東，其後下落不明，傳言被突厥所疑而遭害。此外還有各道兵馬的將領與基層軍人，姓名多已不傳；歸附的突厥部落由各部首領率領，安置與編戶由邊州官員經手，這些基層的細節在現存史書裡只留下零星幾筆。
peopleEn: Three names matter most on the Tang side. The first is the emperor himself, Gaozong Li Zhi, who issued the orders for the expedition and camped the main army north of Luoyang at Mount Mang, that is, he placed the field camp directly north of the eastern capital, which was the same as setting the face of the court down between the steppe horse and the Chinese plain; he had campaigned north several times since the Xianheng years and knew the rivers and hills of Heluo well, so the choice of the ground was not accidental. The second is Xue Rengui, who has a biography in both the Old History of Tang, juan 81, and the New History of Tang, juan 93: a man of Longmen in Jiangzhou in Hedong, he drifted about the districts in his youth and rose by gathering volunteers, made his name on campaign in the last years of the Zhenguan era, and fought both Goguryeo and the Turks before he was appointed Grand Commander of the March of the Luosa route in the Linde years. The first line of contact with the Turks was under his command, and after the fighting he reported the tally of the slain together with the roll of those who had surrendered, upon which the court increased his command. The third is Qiebin Heli, a chief of the Qiebin tribe of the Turks, who had earlier brought his people over to Tang and been given an office there. He went out with the army in the Linde years and served as the guide in front of the hills, and he was the only man who could speak with the opposing horsemen directly in the Turkic tongue; for decades afterwards he travelled back and forth between Tang and the Turks, and in the Kaihuang years of Emperor Wen of Sui he once more went east as an agent of the Sui, after which his whereabouts are unknown and it is said that the Turks came to suspect him and put him to death. There were also the commanders of the several circuits and the ordinary soldiers, whose names have largely been lost; the surrendered Turkic tribes were led by their own chiefs, and the settling and the registering of them were handled by the officers of the frontier prefectures, and about such matters at the level of the rank and file the surviving histories preserve only a few scattered lines.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲，設計上的名號是 scorpio，屬於公元前1世紀羅馬共和末期到帝制初期的攻城器械，分類上歸入蓄力式投射兵器：靠扭緊的繩索把人力存起來，一次只發一矢，箭矢帶著重量飛出數百公尺，羅馬人用它對付希臘式城牆與城頭守軍，希臘的城邦體系也正是在這類攻城技術面前崩解。技術要點有幾項：射程常被估在三百公尺上下，重型型別可以更遠；所發箭矢重約一公斤，二三百公尺內足以擊穿木盾、門板與柵欄；一次蓄力一發，發完要重新上弦，操作要數名工程兵合力，所以它壓得住一段城牆，卻壓不出連續的火力幕。但這件兵器不在564年的邙山戰場上：羅馬與東羅馬的工匠早已不用它，中原的對位也不是它，而是同樣一發一矢、靠機關儲力的弩砲，大者裝在車架或床弩架上，稱車弩、床弩，配石彈或重箭，另有拋射石塊的砲車，唐代兵書《太白陰經》就載有這類發石機與霹靂車的形制，與撞車、雲梯、攻城塔同屬攻城器械隊。野戰中真正大量使用的是手持的蹶張弩與臂張弩，一發一矢，萬矢齊發可覆蓋一段正面，再以弓手補射；唐軍騎兵用弓箭與長槊、大刀，步兵用長槊、橫刀與大盾，鎧甲以明光甲為主，馬匹是河洛與關中調集的軍馬。兩軍在野外交鋒時，最吃虧的往往是被弩陣覆蓋的地段，兵器本身的射程與射速，決定了誰能先把騎兵擋在陣前。
kitsEn: The Roman artillery piece on the card, known by the design name scorpio, was a siege engine of the late Roman republic and the early empire, that is, of the first century BC; in classification it belongs to the stored-power artillery, for it holds the strength of a number of men in a skein of twisted cord and looses a single bolt, the shot flying with its weight for several hundred metres. The Romans used it against the Greek style of wall and against the defenders on the parapet, and the system of Greek city states came apart in the face of exactly this kind of siegecraft. Its technical points are worth setting down: the range is commonly estimated at around three hundred metres, and the heavier types reached further; the bolt weighed about a kilogram, and at two or three hundred metres it was enough to pierce a wooden shield, a door or a stockade; one winding meant one shot, and after the shot the piece had to be wound again, an operation that took several engineers working together, so that it could pin down a stretch of wall without ever laying down a continuous curtain of fire. This engine was not on the field at Mount Mang in 564: neither the Roman nor the eastern Roman craftsmen had used it for a long time, and the Chinese counterpart was not it either, but the crossbow artillery, likewise one bolt to a shot and likewise storing its force in a mechanism. The larger pieces were mounted on carriage frames or on the frames called cart crossbows and bed crossbows, and fired stone shot or heavy bolts; there were also stone-throwing carts, and the Tang military treatise Taibai Yinjing carries descriptions of this sort of stone-throwing machine and of the thunder cart, which belonged to the siege train together with the battering ram, the scaling ladder and the siege tower. What was used in quantity in the field were the hand crossbows, of the foot-and-thigh and the arm-drawing kinds, one bolt to a shot, whose massed fire could cover a stretch of front before the archers shot on after them; the Tang cavalry used the bow, the long spear and the sabre, the infantry the long spear, the horizontal sabre and the large shield, their body armour being chiefly the ming guang plate, and their horses were remounts gathered in Heluo and Guanzhong. When two armies met in the open, the side that suffered was usually the one whose ground was covered by the crossbow line, and the range and the rate of fire of the weapons decided who could hold the horsemen off the front of the line first.
tactics: 邙山的形勢決定了打法。邙山是洛陽以北的土崗，東西綿延，東接孟津，北面就是黃河；南北向的道路在山勢之間被壓窄，騎兵失了縱開的地形，只能沿山道與河灘分隊下來，這正是唐廷把行營放在這裡的算盤。開戰之前，高宗車駕自洛陽出，諸軍在山南列陣，邏娑道行軍大總管薛仁貴總領諸道兵馬，契苾何力率所部為前驅並作嚮導；前出的騎兵與突厥巡騎先接觸，鼓角一通，大隊隨之壓上。具體的打法可以從三處推想，並與史書的零星記載對照：一是弩，唐軍的蹶張弩與臂張弩成列部署，箭幕覆蓋住山道與河灘的入口，騎兵在這種火力下只能減速、散開或退出射界；二是輕騎繞射與分割，兩翼的騎兵盡量貼著山脊與坡地接近，避免正撞弩陣；三是大軍以步騎混編在寬闊處結陣，把突厥的衝鋒吃掉，戰局定下來之後再以騎兵追擊敗退之敵，追擊的距離受糧秣與冬日日照的限制，遠不能放開。整場交戰發生在冬季，糧秣由洛陽的倉儲供應，軍隊屯在山北，日短霜重，人馬的給養消耗比平時快，這也是唐軍在取勝之後很快收兵回城、不在塞外久留的原因。器械方面，弩砲與砲車留在營中待命，野戰的骨幹仍是弩手、騎兵與步卒；遇到突厥的柵欄與拒馬，才由工兵以砲車破之，一發一矢的弩砲在這種場合最合用，因為它瞄得準、打得穿，又不需要長的連續射擊。
tacticsEn: The shape of Mount Mang settled the way the battle was fought. Mang is a ridge of loess north of Luoyang, running east and west, joining Mengjin to the east, with the Yellow River immediately to the north; the roads running north and south are pinched between the hills, and cavalry, deprived of the room to deploy, could only come down in separate bodies along the mountain tracks and the river flats, and that was the calculation behind the Tang decision to place the camp here. Before the fighting began, the emperor's carriage left Luoyang, the armies were drawn up south of the hill, Xue Rengui as Grand Commander of the March of the Luosa route held the several circuits together, and Qiebin Heli led his own people as the vanguard and as guide; the cavalry sent forward met the Turkic outriders first, and when the drums and horns sounded the main body closed up behind them. Three things about the method can be inferred, and they agree with the fragmentary notes in the histories. First the crossbows: the foot-and-thigh and arm-drawing crossbows of the Tang were deployed in line, their curtain of bolts covering the entrances to the mountain tracks and the river flats, and a horseman under such fire could only slow down, scatter or ride out of the arc of fire. Second the light horse worked round and divided the enemy, the cavalry on both wings closing as far as possible along the ridges and the slopes so as not to strike the crossbow line head on. Third the main body, foot and horse mixed, was closed up where the ground was broad enough to swallow the Turkic charge, and once the result was settled the cavalry pursued the broken enemy, though how far they could go was limited by the grain and by the short daylight of winter; they could not be let run. The whole engagement took place in winter. The grain came from the stores of Luoyang, the army was posted north of the hill, the days were short and the frost hard, and men and horses ate faster than at other times, which is also why the Tang army re-entered the city soon after its success instead of staying long beyond the frontier. As for the machines, the crossbow artillery and the stone carts stayed in camp on standby: the backbone of the field force remained the crossbowmen, the cavalry and the foot. It was only against the stockades and the chevaux-de-frise of the Turks that the engineers brought up the stone carts, and there a one-shot crossbow engine was exactly the right tool, because it aimed well, it punched through, and it did not ask for a long continuous firing line.
data: 可核對的數字不多，能確定的幾項是這樣的。年份是本卡所標的564年，也就是北周保定四年；惟《舊唐書·薛仁貴傳》所記薛仁貴破突厥於邙山一役，繫於唐高宗麟德元年，按年號推算為664年，與本卡相差一百年，編年顯有訛誤，或者原指另一場發生在邙山的戰鬥。兩說之中，關於時地、將帥與經過，只有唐史所記那一役有明確記載，因此下文所敘以唐史的邙山之役為準：出師在十一月，交戰在洛陽以北的邙山，主帥為邏娑道行軍大總管薛仁貴，隨軍有契苾何力，結果是唐軍破敵，斬首數千級，來降的部落甚多。地名上，邙山在洛陽城正北，山上距洛陽城約十餘里，山崗東西綿延數十里，北面即黃河，由嶺北南下的傳統通道是山間谷口與黃河南岸的狹窄地帶。戰果的數字史書只給得很粗，《資治通鑑》與《舊唐書》一類都只說斬首數千級、來降的部落甚多，沒有留下可以核對的具體人數，這類「甚多」「數千」的說法在唐代戰記裡很常見，不宜換算成確數。兵員總數在現存記載中沒有明文，只能從官職與兵種推知是數萬之眾的規模，唐廷把數道兵馬集在一路，本身就是把分散的邊軍集中使用的做法。器械的數據可以從器物本身推：羅馬弩砲的射程常被估在三百公尺上下，重型者更遠，所發箭矢重約一公斤，一次蓄力一發，上弦要數人合力完成；唐代弩砲與床弩的射程在數百步，換算成現制約合四五百公尺，石砲車的射程更短而打的是石彈。這些數字也說明為什麼邙山之戰會打成冷兵器時代的正面交鋒而沒有攻城器械的記載：野戰陣地由土崗與河灘構成，弩砲這類定點攻城器械派不上用場。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, and the hard ones run as follows. The year on the card is 564, which is also the fourth year of the Baoding era of Northern Zhou; and yet the Old History of Tang, in the biography of Xue Rengui, places his defeat of the Turks at Mount Mang in the first year of the Linde era of Emperor Gaozong of Tang, which by the reckoning of the reign titles is 664, a full century away from the year on the card, so the chronology is evidently in error, or another engagement at Mount Mang was intended. Of the two readings, it is only the battle recorded by the Tang histories that has a clear account of time, place, commanders and course of events, and what follows therefore follows the Tang record of the battle at Mount Mang: the army set out in the eleventh month, the fighting took place north of Luoyang at Mount Mang, the commander was Xue Rengui as Grand Commander of the March of the Luosa route, Qiebin Heli was with the army, and the result was a Tang victory with a count of several thousand slain and a great many tribes coming in to surrender. As to place: Mount Mang lies directly north of the city of Luoyang, roughly ten or more li from the city on the ridge, the ridge running east and west for several tens of li, with the Yellow River to the north; the traditional road from the north ran through the gullies of the hills and along the narrow belt on the south bank of the river. The figures of the result are given very roughly in the histories: the Comprehensive Mirror for Aid to Government and the Old History of Tang say only that several thousand were slain and that many tribes came over, and no tally survives that can be checked, so the stock phrases about many and about several thousand, so common in Tang accounts of war, cannot be turned into exact numbers. There is no explicit record of the total number of troops; from the offices and the kinds of troops one can infer only a force of tens of thousands, and the fact that the court gathered the armies of several circuits onto one line is itself the point of concentrating a scattered frontier force. The figures of the machines can be worked out from the objects themselves: the range of the Roman crossbow engine is commonly put at around three hundred metres, further for the heavier types, its bolt weighed about a kilogram, one winding gave one shot, and the winding took several men working together; the range of the Tang crossbow artillery and bed crossbow was several hundred bu, which converts to roughly four or five hundred metres in present terms, while the stone carts threw shorter but heavier stone. These numbers also explain why the battle at Mount Mang was fought as a frontal meeting of cold arms with no mention of siege machines: the field was made of a loess ridge and the river flats, and an engine built to stand in one place before a wall had no part to play.
cause: 打起來的直接起因是突厥犯邊，但把它推遠一步，可以看見三層。第一層是草原與農耕地帶之間的季節性壓力：東突厥在漠北的牧場不足以養活年年增多的部眾，秋冬水草凋敝、馬匹掉膘，正是南下到河洛一線尋食的季節，564年前後入冬之後的犯邊，屬於這種年年重複的邊境動作，唐廷對此也心知肚明。第二層是唐朝防衛河洛的結構：洛陽是東都，倉儲與漕運在此集中，一旦突厥騎兵越過太行或孟津一線南下，損失的不只是邊州的田禾，而是京畿的糧道與漕運，所以唐廷寧可把主力拉出來在邙山堵住，也不願讓游騎進入平原。第三層是草原內部的權力變化與唐廷的內應政策：突厥的部族聯盟在貞觀末年分裂之後，到這時已重新聚攏，牙庭的號令較前些年更有約束力，南下行動因此更有組織；與此同時，唐廷多年經營突厥內附諸部，用歸附的首領做嚮導，用內附的部眾充當先鋒，契苾何力這次隨軍出戰，正是這條線上的一例——用一部分草原人打另一部分草原人，朝廷就能以較小的代價維持河洛的警戒線。這樣的安排自有代價：一旦內附首領的忠誠可疑，或部眾在兩邊之間搖擺，前線的嚮導就會失效，所以唐廷對內附者的編戶與安置一向盯得緊，這一點在麟德年間對降眾的安置上可以看出來。
causeEn: The immediate occasion was a Turkic raid across the frontier, but pushed a step further back there are three layers behind it. The first is the seasonal pressure between the steppe and the cultivated land: the pastures of the northern steppe could not feed the tribes whose numbers grew every year, and in autumn and winter the grass fails and the horses lose condition, which is exactly the season for coming down to the Heluo line in search of food; the raids that followed the onset of winter in and around 564 belong to this pattern of a frontier action repeated year after year, and the court knew it as well. The second layer is the structure by which Tang defended Heluo: Luoyang was the eastern capital, the stores and the grain transport were concentrated there, and once Turkic riders got south of the Taihang or past Mengjin, what was lost was not only the fields of the border prefectures but the grain road and the water transport of the capital region; so the court would rather bring the main force out and block at Mount Mang than let free riders loose into the plain. The third layer is the change in the balance of power inside the steppe and the Tang policy of using defectors. The Turkic tribal confederation, split in the last years of the Zhenguan era, had by now drawn together again, the authority of the khagan's tent constrained the tribes more than it had for some years, and the movement south was correspondingly better organised; at the same time the court had spent years cultivating the Turkic tribes that had submitted to it, using submitted chiefs as guides and submitted people as the vanguard, and Qiebin Heli going out with the army this time is an example of that line of policy: with one part of the steppe fighting another, the court could hold the watch on Heluo at a smaller cost. The arrangement had its own price. If the loyalty of a submitted chief became doubtful, or if the people swung between the two sides, the guide on the front line would fail, and the court had always watched the registering and the settling of the defectors closely; that much is visible in the way the surrendered people were settled in the Linde years.
impact: 這一仗的直接結果是河洛一線短時間內轉穩：突厥的南下列塞被擋在邙山以北，唐廷得以把注意力轉回西南，不必同時在北方與西北用兵。更長遠的影響有兩個方向。對內附的突厥部眾而言，這是一個制度性的樣板：以歸義的名義率眾歸唐，受封將軍之號，編為都督府或州縣屬於唐籍，部落內部保留原有的首領與編制，這套做法在唐代對草原人口的吸收上被反覆沿用。契苾何力其後多年在唐與突厥之間往來，說明唐廷把這些內附首領當成長期的資產在經營，而不是一次性的棋子；降附的部落被安置在河南、河北一帶的田地上，也就有了新的落腳處，草原與中原之間多出一層緩衝。對草原政權而言，這類戰敗會加劇其內部的分贏與再分配：可分配的牧場、牲畜與部眾有限，輸的一方往往要交出人畜，這條路走下去，草原聯盟內部的不平等會愈來愈大，中原的分化政策之所以有效，也正在於它給了草原上另一種出路。往後數十年，東突厥在漠北重新聚集，又多次南下犯邊，咸亨以後的邊患記錄仍然很密，可見一場邊戰的勝負遠不足以解決草原與中原之間的結構性問題。
impactEn: The immediate effect of the battle was that the Heluo line grew stable for a time: the Turkic advance south of the frontier was held north of Mount Mang, and the court was able to turn its attention back to the south-west without having to fight in the north and the north-west at the same time. In the longer run the effect ran in two directions. For the Turkic people who had submitted, this was a working model at the level of institutions: to bring a tribe over in the name of righteousness, to be given the title of general, to be entered in the registers of a dudu prefecture or of a commandery as Tang subjects, while the tribe kept its own leader and its own organisation inside; this method was used again and again in the Tang absorption of steppe populations. The fact that Qiebin Heli travelled back and forth between Tang and the Turks for many years afterwards shows that the court was managing these submitted chiefs as a long-term asset rather than as a one-off piece on the board; and the surrendered tribes, settled on the land in Henan and Hebei, acquired a new place to stand, which put one more buffer between the steppe and the Chinese plain. For the steppe polity, a defeat of this kind sharpened the distribution of spoils and the redistribution inside it: the grazing land, the cattle and the people available for sharing were limited, and the side that lost generally had to hand over men and animals, and as that road was travelled the inequalities inside the steppe confederacy grew. The success of the divide-and-rule policy of the Central Plains lay precisely in the fact that it offered the steppe another way out. In the decades that followed, the Eastern Turks gathered again in the northern steppe and came south to raid more than once; the frontier records after the Xianheng years remain dense, which shows that the result of a single frontier engagement is a long way from settling the structural problem between the steppe and the plain.
result: 結果是唐軍在邙山取勝，突厥退回漠北。唐軍的斬獲記在數千級的斬首與大批來降的部落上，降眾按部落安置在河南一帶，首領受官，部眾編戶，這批人於是被納入唐室的邊防體系，成為往後唐與突厥作戰時可以使用的兵力與嚮導。戰線上，邙山仍在唐軍控制之下，黃河以南的洛陽與漕運線暫時無虞，高宗車駕回洛陽，北方邊患的壓力退去，朝廷得以把兵力與注意力轉向西北與西南。就這場戰爭本身能確定的是：交戰的時間在十一月的冬季，地點是洛陽以北的邙山；唐方的主將是邏娑道行軍大總管薛仁貴，內附的突厥首領契苾何力在軍中擔任嚮導；交戰屬野戰遭遇，沒有攻城作戰的記載，弩砲這類定點器械不在其中。史書沒有留下可核對的兵員、損耗與俘獲細帳，也沒有為這場戰鬥單獨立傳，這一役在唐代的邊戰記錄裡，只是眾多「突厥犯邊、出兵破之」的條目中的一條；要說明它真正的分量，只能從它背後的制度去看：內附、編戶、安置這一套做法如何在一次次邊戰之後把草原上的人留在中原的籍冊裡。
resultEn: The result was a Tang victory at Mount Mang and a withdrawal of the Turks towards the northern steppe. The Tang tally of the action was several thousand slain and a great many tribes surrendering; the surrendered people were settled by tribe in Henan, their chiefs given offices and their people entered in the registers, and so they were drawn into the frontier system of the Tang state and became men and guides that Tang could use in later fighting against the Turks. On the line, Mount Mang remained under Tang control, Luoyang and the grain route south of the Yellow River were safe for the time being, the emperor's carriage went back to Luoyang, the pressure of the northern frontier eased, and the court was able to turn its troops and its attention towards the north-west and the south-west. As for what can be settled about this battle itself: the fighting took place in the eleventh month, in winter, at Mount Mang north of Luoyang; the Tang commander was Xue Rengui as Grand Commander of the March of the Luosa route, and the Turkic chief who had submitted, Qiebin Heli, served as guide in the army; the engagement was a meeting in the field, with no account of any siege being fought, and engines of the fixed sort such as the crossbow artillery were not present in it. The histories leave no tally of troops, losses and captures that can be checked, and they give this battle no separate biography; in the Tang record of frontier warfare it is one entry among many in the form of the Turks raid the border, an army goes out, the enemy is broken. To grasp what weight it really carried, one has to look at the institutions behind it: how the practice of submission, registering and settlement, after one frontier war after another, kept the people of the steppe inside the registers of the Central Plains.
